title: 三根阳线，你会追吗？订单流确认

lines.text: 三根阳线，你会追吗？
lines.en: Three big green candles. Would you chase?

lines.text: 给你五秒决定。
lines.en: You have 5 seconds.

lines.text: 只看K线，不够。
lines.en: Candles alone are not enough.

lines.text: 接下来，看订单流。
lines.en: Now, read the order flow.

lines.text: 三根阳线，只能说明价格在涨，
lines.en: Three green candles only show that price is rising,

lines.text: 不能证明买方一定还会继续控制市场。
lines.en: not that buyers will stay in control.

lines.text: 第一根阳线：价格向上时，Delta有没有同步变强，
lines.en: Candle 1: as price rises, does Delta grow with it?

lines.text: 主动买盘是不是真的出现了。
lines.en: Are aggressive buyers really there?

lines.text: 回踩时，主动卖单打到买价，价格却不再下跌，
lines.en: On the pullback, sellers hit the bid, yet price stops falling.

lines.text: Footprint在同一区域堆量，
lines.en: Footprint volume stacks at the same levels:

lines.text: 说明可能有买方在吸收。
lines.en: buyers may be absorbing.

lines.text: 确认：吸收后价格重新向上，Delta转强，
lines.en: Confirmation: price turns up after absorption, Delta flips positive,

lines.text: CVD同步抬高，才说明买方还在控盘。
lines.en: and CVD rises with it. Only then are buyers still in control.

lines.text: 反例：第三根放量、Delta很大，价格却不涨，
lines.en: Counter-example: candle 3 has big volume and big Delta, yet price won't rise,

lines.text: 或者上影线很长，
lines.en: or it leaves a long upper wick:

lines.text: 警惕高位吸收和衰竭，不要追。
lines.en: beware absorption at the top and exhaustion. Don't chase.

lines.text: 跳空、涨得太快，
lines.en: Gapping up, running too fast?

lines.text: 先等回踩或修复，别因为连续阳线就在高位追。
lines.en: Wait for a pullback or repair. Don't buy high on a green streak.

lines.text: 入场：等价格回到第一根阳线开盘价，或吸收区，
lines.en: Entry: wait for price to return to candle 1's open or the absorption zone,

lines.text: 看到止跌和Delta转强，再考虑。
lines.en: then look for a stall and Delta turning positive.

lines.text: 止损放在吸收区或结构低点下方，
lines.en: Stop below the absorption zone or the structure low.

lines.text: 目标参考前高、POC、Value Area，或下一个流动性位置。
lines.en: Targets: prior high, POC, Value Area, or the next liquidity level.

lines.text: 记住：Delta跟随，回踩有吸收，CVD或价值迁移确认。
lines.en: Remember: Delta follows, the pullback shows absorption, CVD or value migration confirms.

lines.text: 不是追阳线，
lines.en: Don't chase green candles,

lines.text: 是等订单流确认。
lines.en: wait for order flow to confirm.
